name: recetario-monorepo
description: Monorepo de la plataforma gastronomica RECETARIO (Backend Express + Frontend React)

scripts.dev: npm run ports:clean && concurrently -k -n "BACK,FRONT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix recetario -- --host"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix recetario
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix recetario
scripts.ports:clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000,5173 -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } catch {}; exit 0"
